brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 2x Keyhole hanger (hex-acc-keyhole) on rear faces: accessory:0#-1,0#1 at -1,0,0 slot 1 and accessory:0#1,0#1 at 1,0,0 slot 1. Bases at -1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0 joined with joint bolts.

4x Hook plate (hex-acc-hook) on front faces: accessory:0#-1,0#4 (-1,0 slot4), accessory:0#0,0#4 (0,0 slot4), accessory:0#1,0#4 (1,0 slot4), accessory:0#0,0#5 (0,0 slot5). Each plate provides 2 hooks side-by-side = 8 hooks total for hand tools. meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell horizontal rack (-1,0,0 to 1,0,0) wall-mounted via two keyhole hangers on the rear face (slot 1) and four hook-plate accessories on the front faces (slots 4 and 5) providing 8 hooks. Joint bolts lock the bases, check_build OK mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
